headline: Kalpataru Projects appoints Amit Uplenchwar as CEO-designate

headline: Kalpataru Projects reports 20.4 percent jump in Q2 net profit
hook: Strong order book backs profit growth
summary: Kalpataru Projects International posted a 20.4 percent rise in net profit to Rs 289 crore for the second quarter, up from the previous year. Revenue grew 7.3 percent to Rs 7,004 crore during the same period. The company also reported a strong order book standing at Rs 71,846 crore, supporting its execution pipeline. Retail investors tracking infrastructure stocks can evaluate order book execution trends.
why_it_matters: Robust order book supports earnings visibility for infrastructure investors.
